text:
Priya (PM): Quick sync — launching the new Value Estimator widget this Friday. Need: widget microcopy (2 variants), a short FAQ blurb, a one-paragraph benchmark narrative for the launch post, and routing rules for webinar/demo flows. Who can take which piece?

Trent (Growth): I can do microcopy. Two concise options: A) "Estimate monthly inference cost in seconds — try the estimator." B) "How much will inference cost for your app? Get an instant estimate." Which tone do we want: efficient or conversational? :thinking_face:

Jordan (Content): Tone reccomendation: go efficient for the widget (short CTAs), conversational for the launch post and webinar invites. I can draft the 1-paragraph benchmark narrative after we lock microcopy.

Evelyn (Sales Ops): For routing: if user clicks "Book a demo" send to HubSpot form with hidden field utm_source=estimator and lead_score=auto (from widget selections). High intent (custom token: expects > $5k/mo) -> owner assignment to AE queue. Low intent -> nurture sequence + invite to on-demand webinar.

Sam (Analytics): Metrics to instrument: widget CTR, estimator-to-book-demo rate, avg estimated monthly spend, demo-booking latency, demo->SQL conversion. Suggest targets for the experiment: CTR > 2.5%, demo conversion from estimator > 3%, demo->SQL > 20%.

Priya (PM): Perfect. Jordan + Trent take microcopy + narrative. Sam: can you add the tags/events for analytics? Evelyn: can you confirm the HubSpot hidden field names?

Sam (Analytics): Will add events: `estimator_view`, `estimator_submit`, `estimator_cta_click`, `estimator_book_demo`. Sending the tracking spec in a follow-up. ETA end of day.

Evelyn (Sales Ops): HubSpot hidden fields: `utm_source`, `estimator_revenue_est`, `estimator_tier_guess`. Also add referrer path so we can stitch session to contact. I can wire mapping tomorrow.

Trent (Growth): Microcopy drafts (quick):
Option A (concise):
- Button: "Get estimate"
- Microline: "Estimate monthly inference cost for your app in < 30s."
Option B (conversational):
- Button: "See my cost"
- Microline: "Curious what inference might cost at scale? Get a quick estimate."
Reactions welcome, then I'll A/B test. :bar_chart:

Jordan (Content): Benchmark paragraph draft for launch post (first pass):
"Our Value Estimator benchmarks common LLM workloads across typical sequence lengths and concurrency profiles to provide a near-term cost estimate. For the launch, we measured three archetypes — chat customer support, document ingestion embeddings, and high-throughput summarization — and present 90th-percentile and median per-month cost estimates to help teams budget for production. The estimator uses Redwood Inference’s runtime defaults (autoscaling off, baseline quantization) and shows how batching and KV caching change unit economics; see methodology link for full details."

Priya (PM): Nice — keep it tight, add one sentence with an action: "Try it now or join our 30-min webinar next week for a live walkthrough."

Trent (Growth): Quick FAQ blurb suggestion for embedding on the estimator panel:
Q: How accurate is this estimate?
A: The estimator gives representative ballpark numbers based on typical workloads and our runtime defaults. It is not a formal quote — for production pricing, book a demo. Link to methodology + contact.

Jordan (Content): Microcopy variants for follow-up email CTA: A) "See your estimate in 30s" B) "Get a tailored estimate". Use A for top-of-funnel nurture, B for demo invites.

LaunchBot: Reminder scheduled: publish launch post + widget embed on Friday 10:00 PST. Tweet thread to go live 10:05 PST. :rocket:

Evelyn (Sales Ops): Quick note on flows: include a checkbox "Share my estimate with sales" (opt-in). If checked, map `estimator_revenue_est` to deal properties. Keeps privacy clean.

Sam (Analytics): If we A/B the microcopy, split traffic 50/50, track estimator_submit -> book_demo as primary lift metric. I'll run a 2-week test and return results.

Priya (PM): Great all — action items: Trent finalize A/B lines & push to staging (today), Jordan write launch paragraph + short post (tomorrow AM), Sam implement events + experiment, Evelyn wire HubSpot mapping and opt-in flag. Back here EOD tomorrow with updates. :raised_hands:

Trent (Growth): On it. Will include two variants in the embed JSON and a simple data-attribute `data-variant` for tracking. Example snippet: ```<button class=\"estimator-cta\" data-variant=\"A\">Get estimate</button>```

Jordan (Content): I'll drop the launch post draft in Google Docs and tag Priya.

Sam (Analytics): Added to my board. Will share tracking spec PR before EOD.

Evelyn (Sales Ops): Mapping scheduled for tomorrow AM.

Priya (PM): Thanks — let's reopen thread if anything blocks.
